business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Product lifecycle management (PLM), CAD, ALM and service lifecycle management software for manufacturers

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Subscription software, increasingly SaaS, sold with a partner network for implementation

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Mostly multi-year subscription contracts, typically billed annually

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Predominantly recurring subscription and support revenue, with a smaller perpetual license and services share

implementation_transition_work.label: Implementation / transition work
implementation_transition_work.value: Implementation and deployment largely delivered by global partner network, with some PTC consulting services

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Hybrid: on-premises/customer-hosted plus SaaS offerings such as Windchill+, Creo+ and ServiceMax

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: PLM, CAD, ALM, service lifecycle management, industrial IoT and augmented reality for product development

arr_recurring_base_definition_subscripti.label: ARR / recurring-base definition [subscription software]
arr_recurring_base_definition_subscripti.value: Annualized value of active subscription and support contracts, issuer-defined and reported at period end

notes: Contract terms, retention and deployment mix come from general knowledge, not the evidence; PTC reports ARR but the definition is not in the evidence.
